gradient_rule: two immutable original CPU float32 flat vectors; float64 dot/norm/projection; project iff dot < 0 and other squared norm > 0; cast each projected vector to float32; sum in float32; reject nonfinite output
normalization: each objective is mean squared error over two fixed synthetic scalar targets; equal unit objective weights; sum, not mean, of gradients
ordering: private CPU generator seeded once; initialize two float32 parameters with normal std 0.02; randperm(2) each completed step; each objective projects only against the immutable other original
zero_policy: zero dot is nonconflicting; zero norm never divides; no epsilon or tolerance in conflict test
